message.content:
Based on a comparison of the two screenshots, here are the detected differences (drift):

**1. Top Navigation Bar:**
*   **"Add On" Badge Icon:** In Image 1, the "Add On" text is accompanied by an **'M' icon inside a teal circle**. In Image 2, this has changed to a **green circle with a white dot** (resembling a status indicator or different logo).

**2. Hero Section - Mode Tabs:**
*   **Tab Label:** The third tab in the navigation bar above the "Rodin" title has changed from **"Video"** (Image 1) to **"Image"** (Image 2). Both have a small red notification dot.

**3. Workspace / Central Interface:**
*   **Generate Button & Controls:** The large **"GENERATE" button**, the **lock icon** to its left, and the **settings controls** (`x1`, slider icon) to its right are **present in Image 1 but completely missing from Image 2**.
*   **Advanced Settings Row:** The row containing the **"OFF" toggle**, **"Gen-2.5" dropdown**, and **"High" quality selector** is **present in Image 1 but missing from Image 2**.

**4. Asset Gallery Section:**
*   **Section Visibility:** The entire bottom section containing the **"ASSET" / "EXPLORE" tabs**, the **"Featured" button**, the **search bar**, **Filter dropdown**, and the **asset thumbnail gallery** (showing 3D models with heart icons) is **visible in Image 1 but entirely absent/cut off in Image 2**.

**5. Cookie Preferences Modal:**
*   **Position & Size:** The modal is positioned in the **bottom-right corner** in Image 1, but has moved to the **center-right** in Image 2.
*   **Button Layout:** In Image 1, the "Accept all" and "Preferences" buttons are arranged **horizontally** side-by-side. In Image 2, they are stacked **vertically**.

**Summary of Unchanged Elements:**
The main **HYPER3D logo**, **"7-Day Trial"** button, **"API"**, **"MCP&CLI"**, **"Login"** links, the **"Rodin" hero title**, **"Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready"** subtitle, **quote text**, and the central **"Image to 3D"** upload widget (including sidebar tools like "Image to 3D", "3D Editing", "WorldGen") remain visually unchanged.
